title: Compact-support exchange cube for an arbitrary open restriction
statement: Let Λ be a finite commutative ring and let sq=(g',f',f,g), sqU=(a,p,f,j), sqj=(c,j',j,g), sq'=(b,p',p,c), sqV=(a',p',f',j'), and sqA=(b,a',a,g') be cartesian squares of schemes. Assume f,f',p,p' compactifiable, f',p' quasi-compact, and j,a,j',a' open immersions. On ordinary unbounded derived categories, use the specified support comparisons E of def-asd-open-restriction-comparisons. Let α_f and α_p be the inverses of the named compact-support base-change maps for sq and sq', and O_j and O_a the derived open-extension base-change isomorphisms for sqj and sqA. Then the vertical pasting α_p followed by O_j, postcomposed with the image of E_sqU along Lg*, equals the vertical pasting O_a followed by α_f, precomposed with the image of E_sqV along Lb*. Precisely, (TwoSquare.vComp α_p O_j).whiskerLeft E_sqU.hom = (TwoSquare.vComp O_a α_f).whiskerRight E_sqV.hom. This is a compact-support morphism equation before transposing any exceptional adjunction; it asserts neither invertibility of exceptional base change nor a hypothesis about that invertibility.

proof.text: Apply the cube calculation with the chosen input compactifications and their literal base changes.

Factor each named exchange into raw compactification exchange and the output common-refinement comparison. Apply naturality of the open-support comparison in those two output compactifications. Naturality of the output comparison moves it past the open exchange, and its inverse cancels. Componentwise cancellation and natural-transformation extensionality give the asserted equality.

theorem openRestrictionCompactSupport_cube
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X Y X' Y' U V U' V' : Scheme.{u}}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification f'] [QuasiCompact f']
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    {j : U ⟶ Y} [IsOpenImmersion j] {a : V ⟶ X} [IsOpenImmersion a]
    {p : V ⟶ U} (sqU : IsPullback a p f j) [HasCompactification p]
    {c : U' ⟶ U} {j' : U' ⟶ Y'} [IsOpenImmersion j']
    (sqj : IsPullback c j' j g)
    {b : V' ⟶ V} {p' : V' ⟶ U'} (sq' : IsPullback b p' p c)
    [HasCompactification p'] [QuasiCompact p']
    {a' : V' ⟶ X'} [IsOpenImmersion a'] (sqV : IsPullback a' p' f' j')
    (sqA : IsPullback b a' a g') :
    letI := isIso_rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap Λ sq
    letI := isIso_rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap Λ sq'
    (TwoSquare.vComp
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (inv (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap Λ sq')))
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sqj).hom)
      ).whiskerLeft (openRestrictionCompactSupportIso Λ sqU).hom =
    (TwoSquare.vComp
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _
        (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sqA).hom)
      (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (inv (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap Λ sq)))
      ).whiskerRight (openRestrictionCompactSupportIso Λ sqV).hom
